papers.title_en: Unifying Generative Models with Path Integrals
papers.evidence: 将生成建模表述为路径积分，并在统一作用量框架中处理扩散模型、得分匹配和漂移设计
papers.tldr: 生成建模统一到路径积分框架中，流基、扩散、变分与对抗模型均源于同一主作用量的不同评估方案。该框架的MSRJD形式将自由与相互作用概率流分离，由此引入图解微扰展开。一阶圈图修正以确定性采样方式实现，免去随机采样开销，在可解和非线性漂移测试中将树级误差从53%压低至1.6%。不完美学习分数作为算符插入，自然导出响应加权的分数匹配目标；对称等变的漂移设计则被重构为带EFT功率计数的算符展开。
papers.abstract_en: We formulate generative modeling as a path integral in which flow-based, diffusion-based, variational, and adversarial models arise as different evaluation principles for a single master action. Its Martin-Siggia-Rose-Janssen-de~Dominicis (MSRJD) form separates free from interacting probability flows and opens them to diagrammatic perturbation theory. The expansion yields a one-loop correction to deterministic samplers at no stochastic-sampling cost, which we validate on solvable and nonlinear drifts, where it reduces a 53 % tree-level error to 1.6 %. Imperfect learned scores enter as insertions and yield a response-weighted score-matching objective, and symmetry-equivariant drift design becomes an operator expansion with EFT power counting.

papers.authors: Pierre Del Moral, Ajay Jasra, Ke Zhao
papers.evidence: 直接研究两个混合概率测度之间通过薛定谔桥进行桥接
papers.tldr: 桥接两个混合概率测度是生成建模与概率迁移中的基础问题。针对混合组分间仅给定马尔可夫核的场景，本文提出一种基于参考扩散的熵最优桥接机制，并严格证明其最优性。为了实用化，作者聚焦高斯混合与薛定谔桥，借助ε协方差膨胀和扰动Riccati映射分析，建立了精确桥与近似桥之间的2-Wasserstein连续性上界，给出EM参数估计下O((d logN/N)^{1/2}+ε^2)等收敛率。数值实验验证了理论，为混合分布间的样本转换提供了严谨且可行的框架。
papers.abstract_en: In this article we consider bridging between two mixture probability measures. In particular, given access to a Markov kernel between two component distributions, we provide a general mechanism to generate samples from one mixture to the other. Associated to a given reference and extended state space, we prove entropic optimality of this approach. In order to use this idea one needs to know the underlying mixtures and the Markov kernel, which is seldom available, and so we consider the case of Gaussian mixtures and Schrödinger Bridges. We prove a general $2-$Wasserstein continuity bound between the exact bridge and one that is approximated, based on $ε-$covariance inflation, and these rely on a novel continuity analysis of perturbed Riccati maps. We apply our results in the context of bridging mixtures of Gaussians, single Gaussians and empirical estimators of the Gaussian parameters and the Monge map. For mixtures of Gaussians, when the parameters are estimated using the Expectation-Maxmization algorithm, the upper-bound on the $2-$Wasserstein distance between the true and approximated bridges is, under assumptions and with probability at least $1-10N^{-1}$, $\mathcal{O}\big(\big[\big(\tfrac{d\log N}{N}\big)^{1/2}\left\{1+\big(\tfrac{d\log N}{N}\right)^{1/2}(ε^{-2}+1)\big\}+ε^2\big]\big) $ and for the other two cases, in expectation, $\mathcal{O}\left(d\left\{\tfrac{1+ε^{-2}}{1+N}+ε^2\right\}\right)$, where $d,N\in\mathbb{N}$ is the dimension of the Gaussian and the number of empirical samples respectively. We also investigate our bounds numerically.
